newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in thin trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.88 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 471.72 points, down from 475.92 on Thursday.
Total volume was 850,558 dinars against 1.15 million dinars over the previous session.
Cola and beer bottler SFBT fell 2.54 dinars to 86.2 dinars. Chemical firm Al-Kimia slid one dinar to 44.
Amen Bank was down 0.94 dinar to 30.84 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole eased 0.77 dinar to 24.99 dinar with 8,891 shares changing hands. Banque du Sud edged lower 0.74 dinar to 24.09 dinars.

Milk firm Tunisie Lait declined 0.7 dinar to 23.04 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF eased 0.46 dinar to 15.52. Placement de Tunisie was down 0.34 dinar to 11.28 dinars. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel fell 0.28 dinar to 10.2. Airline Tunis Air edged lower 0.2 dinar to 23.5 dinars.
Arab Tunisian Bank was up 0.28 dinar to 29 dinars. ($1=1.1024 dinar)
